case_title: TARA LAYMAN ET AL VS. DAN PERATA TRAINING INC.

docket_entries.description: STIPULATION TO ALLOW THE CASE TO BE HEARD BEFORE A JUDGE PRO TEM FILED BY LAYMAN, TARA DAOUD, NICOLE DAN PERATA TRAINING INC.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) NATASHA PERATA, PARTNER/OWNER & DAN PERATA, PARTNER/OWNER FILED BY DEFENDANT DAN PERATA TRAINING INC.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-05-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-05-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM GROVER. PLAINTIFF TARA LAYMAN IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF NICOLE DAOUD IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DAN PERATA TRAINING, INC IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY NATASHA PERATA, PARTNER/OWNER AND DAN PERATA PARTNER/OWNER, OTHER APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT'S WITNESSES: JOSHUA JARAMILLO, JOSHUA DAY, AND STEPHANIE TATE. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ERIC GROVER; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-05-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LAYMAN, TARA DAOUD, NICOLE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DAN PERATA TRAINING INC. PLAINTIFFS SHALL TAKE NOTHING ON THEIR COMPLAINT. PLAINTIFFS DID NOT PROVE THEIR CASE BY A PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE. THE DISPUTE IS OVER THE QUALITY OF THE SERVICES NOT WHETHER SERVICES WERE PROVIDED. PLAINTIFFS DID NOT PROVE THAT SERVICES WERE NOT PROVIDED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $8,000.00 FILED BY LAYMAN, TARA DAOUD, NICOLE AS TO DEFENDANT DAN PERATA TRAINING INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-05-2023 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$40.00);REMARKS: RESPONDENT (DAN PERATA) CAME TO THE SHERIFF'S OFFICE AT CITY HALL, ROOM 456 AND WAS SERVED THE DOCUMENTS. SERVED MAY-02-2023, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT DAN PERATA TRAINING INC.
